notes.title: LiveWire 15- Jungle Bungle is here! Play and win Steam Gift Cards for $20!
notes.content:
It's hot and tense within the city limits and the rowdy racers have gone off into the jungle for bit of a wild adventure and to blow off some steam.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35370091/f18f38115f730ab0b12f22a12b58c55cbe5c4cf1.png

Things take a nasty turn when Mark Suplex decides to turn up in a safari hat aboard the growling Rhyno bike and throws an open challenge to his not-so-mild-mannered colleagues for a long sprint down the bumpy and treacherous jungle trail!

What might have started as a gentle cruise in the lap of nature has quickly turned into one of the fastest and most challenging races for the Rude Racers! Jungle Bungle is a very tricky proposition with high-speed turns, plenty of ramps and the constant threat of some lunatic trying to push you into a boulder with a lead pipe or giant mallet!

That's enough talking for now and it's time to get dirty in the woods-- checkout this fast and furious fifteenth instalment of Rude Racers' LiveWire series and post your best time to the leaderboard to win Steam Gift Cards!

The Steam Summer Sale might be over but things are reaching boiling point in Rude Racers with the tenth instalment of the LiveWire series- Rolling Thunder!

notes.title: LiveWire #9 "Bad Blood" is here! Compete and win Steam Gift Cards worth $30!
notes.content:
A few weeks have passed since we announced the fast and thrilling LiveWire #8 event- Tricycle Terror and while we had planned to move ahead with a full release of Rude Racers' Early Access, the pesky virus and it's unfortunate repercussions have forced us to postpone things a little longer. 


Regardless of these little setbacks, rest assured that the pack of hounds at Famous Dogg is as hungry as ever to continue to deliver gut-busting, hell-raising and truly fast and furious action in Rude Racers!


We are pleased to introduce the first cross-platform LiveWire event for event no. 9 in the LiveWire Series- Bad Blood! This is the first time that users on Steam and Android (using Google Play Game Services) can compete with each other for the top three spots!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35370091/48a1c9768a52207e2a230f93744663403a966b65.png


Bad Blood is no ordinary race and the stakes are high as it is now a matter of pride and respect when it comes to the bitter and old rivalry between cousins Jose Hoodlum and Speedy Sanchez. With racing in their DNA and a constant competition for the bragging rights in the world of mean street racing, the rivalry hit boiling point when Jose got his own custom red Torpedo bike to rival Sanchez's blue Torpedo.


It's now time to settle the score as the two decide to go off the city limits and put their racing and combat skills to the ultimate test at the slippery and danger-prone shipyard. Fire up Rude Racers NOW, take control of Jose Hoodlum and ride out on his fiery new Torpedo bike in an intense Head 2 Head battle to teach Sanchez a lesson he'd never forget!


Since this LiveWire is the "Chosen One" to go along with the big launch of Rude Racers, we are also upping the ante and increasing the cash that we are giving out to the top three racers in the form of Steam Gift Cards:
First place- $15
Second place- $10
Third place- $5 With gift cards of a total worth at $30, this is the biggest and most rewarding event in the LiveWire series to date!

notes.title: LiveWire #8 is finally here! Compete and win Steam Gift Cards worth $30!
notes.content:
So it's been a crazy few weeks for the Famous Dogg team as we've been trying to keep the motor running amidst all the chaos that seems to be going on around the world and while staying at home is by no means our favourite thing to do, we've been keeping ourselves busy preparing for the full-release of Rude Racers (Finally!)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35370091/d97423fadb900081fb321d55e4f6ca3e2e0515dc.png

As we add the finishing touches to the game and work out a firm date for the launch, we are back to deliver your monthly dose of crazy speed and thunderous action in the latest instalment of the LiveWire series!

In Tricycle Terror, you get to play a proper bad*ss as you take control of the exclusive tricycle bike which is not featured in any other game mode! Complete with his tough denims and a leather jacket, Mark Suplex makes a comeback as your pilot for this high stakes run because let's face it, if you're going to smack some copper with a lead pipe and get busted, you'll want them beefy wrists that can deal with the handcuffs xD

The knockout race featured in this LiveWire event is exceptionally challenging and perilous with tight spaces, plenty of obstacles, menacing rivals and dozens of ramps! Fire up Rude Racers and enter the LiveWire zone to find out if you would fly or fall in this fast and furious sprint.. and remember to keep an eye on that timer at top of your screens-- if it's red, you're good as dead!!

Since this LiveWire is the "Chosen One" to go along with the big launch of Rude Racers, we are also upping the ante and increasing the cash that we are giving out to the top three racers in the form of Steam Gift Cards:
First place- $15 
Second place- $10
Third place- $5

With gift cards of a total worth at $30, this is the biggest and most rewarding event in the LiveWire series to date!

And since you're here, why not show your support for your favourite team of lunatic game devs by getting your friends to cough up a dollar (YES! A FREGGIN DOLLAR!!) for one of the last few Early Access copies of this supremely fun combat-racer.. you know they'd love you for it :)

'Right then... enough talking and it's time to ride- stay home and stay safe, people! For all the craziness that you need, remember, it's only a couple of clicks away!

Update to v1.3.1 of the Rude Racers' Early Access and check out the most competitive mode that we have designed so far. Power your bike down the road and obliterate anything that stands in your path as you push your driving skills to the very limit to reach the top of the leaderboard!

notes.title: Please nominate Rude Racers for Steam Awards 2019
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35370091/c54bc110ce172e57c30520f804ce69fb2efb1ce9.jpg

Hello Racers!!

Let us start by first thanking you all for all the support that each and every one of you has shown not just during the Early Access phase but all through the development of the game. Dozens of users spent hours playing each level and each season and came back to us with their detailed feedback which was absolutely central to our efforts in improving and optimising Rude Racers. So once again, a BIG thanks to you all for being super awesome!

Ever since the game was launched in late October this year, hundreds have played and enjoyed Rude Racers- bikes have been sent flying into concrete walls, thousands of barrels have exploded and the cops.. boy have they got their work cut out in dealing with you reckless street racers!

Our ambition with Rude Racers was to make a fun racing game that could keep the users engaged with a tremendous variety in the types of events while being the first proper racing game where melee combat was deeply ingrained into its basic concept and played a major part in how the users develop strategies and build their own unique style as they power through the races in the different season. 

You've helped this far and now we call upon you to please consider nominating Rude Racers for the 2019 Steam Awards. Now we might not win and that's fine but we always have looked at our users as a part of the team-- you guys are in it just as much as ourselves so why not try and see where we can take Rude Racers :)

So go ahead, drop us a nomination and if we get big, you get big too! Turbo Tommy even got a suit on in anticipation (though he couldn't get the helmet off!)

About the category- "Best Game You Suck At":
Anyone who has played Rude Racers would agree that the game has a way of really pushing you to the limit of your driving and combat skills. With dangerous obstacles, menacing cops and the intense, relentless competition of the races, our users have constantly told us how there are few other games that can top the satisfaction that one feels after beating a challenging event in Rude Racers! It's always had that "one more race" appeal to it and we have worked quite hard to keep that intensity and addiction at the centre of the overall experience. 

It is for this reason that we have picked the nomination category as the "Best Game You Suck At" because despite the consistently high level of challenge and it's unrivalled intensity that will punish your slightest mistake, Rude Racers will always have you coming back for more edge-of-your-seat racing action!

notes.title: The Difficulty Patch is here- Improved Easy mode in Rude Racers!
notes.content:
Time for another update, though not a major one but rather important. 

Some users expressed their concerns with the game's Easy mode as they felt it wasn't easy enough given the enormous reduction in the prize money. So we've gone ahead and made it further easier!

Now technically, even a 3 year old should be able to play the game and if you are still struggling in the Easy mode, we offer remedial classes for noobs so you can head over to our website and register ːsteammockingː  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35370091/9c95ac695e6985dabe9f7d1ddc68bd62ec6b2cc8.png

Jokes apart, it's perfectly normal for one to start with Easy mode, get acquainted with the gameplay mechanics and then shift the difficulty. We highly recommend everyone to play the game in Normal and Hard difficulty as that's where the real fun exists!

As always, we highly appreciate you support and feedback. If there are any suggestions or feedback feel free to reach out either on the community hub, steam chat or twitter(our DMs are open).  

Stay Rude!!

notes.title: Halloween Special DLC: GONE HAUNTING available for FREE!
notes.content:

notes.title: Season 4: Rush Hour now LIVE!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=1vzh3ITNjr8;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]
Your favourite team of Rude devs is back with BANG!

------------------------
Season 4: Rush Hour is here and the action is bigger and more explosive than ever. PREPARE TO SMASH ANYTHING THAT MOVES!!

notes.title: New version with wider tracks is LIVE!
notes.content:
Racers!! We're back with another update to the Rude Racers beta!

A lot of you've been enjoying the new season and have sent us some feedback through chat/ email and social media etc and we really appreciate the support so far. 

We've been listening to all your suggestions have a sweet update for you just in time for the weekend. 

The biggest (literally) addition to this update is the wider play area! For those who've wanted a bigger playground for their hell-raising antics, we've added some inches to keep you satisfied...

Here's a summary of the changes:
- Wider tracks
- Fixed some missing data for achievements. Kill more peds, beat up more cops and break more stuff to unlock some new achievements!
- Slight tweak to Knockout races- if you destroy the last racer and you're second to last, the timer will now be reset. It's not how the race was meant to be but it will probably seem fairer this way.

Get in there and *batman voice* LIGHT IT UP!

We're working on new and dedicated crash animations for all obstacles and will soon be brining the game into Early Access. Thanks as always for your support and keep racing and fighting hard!

notes.title: Season 3 patch v1.2.1. Introducing in-game stats!
notes.content:
The first patch to the Season 3 update of Rude Racers is now available in v1.2.1 Beta

Some of you rookies found it too much to deal with the cops so we've tweaked the enforcers' AI to take it easy with you :p

We are also very thankful to those testers who go out their way and post videos about Rude Racers and stream the game-- not only does this help ease the burden of promotion activity on us devs but it gives us great insights into how users are getting on with different aspects of the game.

Here's a quick summary of the improvements and additions in this patch:

- The third season has been revised to achieve better difficulty progression

- In-game statistics are also here at last! Just go to the home screen and pop up the Stats menu to get an overview of the carnage that you've caused! From pedestrian kills to the number of times you set the streets ablaze with NOS, all your rude shenanigans are now here for you to check out!

- We have now added the ability to cycle through menu options using shoulder buttons LB and RB on Xbox controllers

- We have also adjusted the volume settings for those who wanted louder effects and softer music. We get it-- you love to hear the painful grunts of your rivals-- we aren't judging!

That's enough small-talk for now-- it's time to ride!!
Update to v.1.2.1 and let us know your thoughts

notes.title: Season 3: Lawless is now LIVE!
notes.content:
The enforcers are here at last..

We are super excited to announce the arrival of Season 3: Lawless to Rude Racers beta!

The cops have had enough of the street racing menace and they are here to lay down the law!

Experience some of the most nail-biting action in Rude Racers with the pesky cops on the prowl. New bikes and quicker rivals means that the action is crazier and wackier than ever!

The situation escalates after the cops take away your beloved Ranger bike-- hunt down the tow truck and fight to bring her back in the all new Recovery events!

Smash through the road blocks, speed through new environments and feel the adrenaline rush in the fieriest season of Rude Racers!

We have also made other changes and improvements:

 Steam Cloud should now work for game progress and control configuration
 We have revised the Kits selection menu-- you can now buy even a single kit
 Season 2 now has a brand new track- Old Town. Dare to venture into the dark streets of this treacherous new zone! 


As always, your feedback is the most important thing for us and community participation from our testers is what keeps us motivated to do better work! Let us know your throughs here or on the group and feel free to post your screenshots and videos!

steamcommunity.com/groups/rrbeta

Happy racing!

notes.title: No holds barred in this patch! New update introduces greater rival engagement
notes.content:
As we continue to work away on bringing the action-packed Season 3 to Beta, we have managed to make some improvements to the gameplay and the overall app experience that we thought you guys would love to check out!

We've looked at the playthrough videos that some of our testers have uploaded and have discussed the difficulty and the in-game combat with many of you and decided that we need to turn up the heat a little more! 

There is no ridiculously overpowered AI here but some very well thought out adjustments to the rival racers' behaviour that we believe will provide the perfect level of challenge to our users without compromising on the fun-factor and sense of achievement and progress. 

We've also taken onboard other feedback and suggestions regarding the UI from our users- here's a summary of changes:


 Improvements to AI and increased engagement in combat
 You can now use the B button on XInput to go back to the previous screen
 Added a handy help menu on all screens with details of menu navigation controls
 Increased the Cash reward for the the last two levels of Season 2
 Added two new achievements. Win consecutive Quickplay events to unlock!
 Corrected some issues on Windows when running the application in windowed mode


Thanks for all your support and we'll be back very soon with Season 3- LAWLESS!

The streets beckon... it's time to play THE game!

notes.title: Patch to fix lost progress from previous version
notes.content:
Hello racers!

So we should thank yall for all your support this far and helping us test this game. We appreciate it!

As those of you who updated to the last version 1.1.2 would know, there was an issue in the this version whereby an incorrect file path caused many of you to lose your game progress. For this, we apologise.

This has now been taken care of and when you update to v1.1.3, you will (hopefully!) get back your progress from before-- please do let us know if you face any issues and we'll squash the bugs with a hammer because that's what we do!

We hope you're enjoying the achievements so far and we will surely add more. 
Stay tuned as Season 3 with cops, trucks, cattle prods and so much more is coming next week... 

stay rude!

notes.title: New update is LIVE! Introducing ACHIEVEMENTS and an improved Season 2.. get in there!!
notes.content:
Stoked to announce a revised Season 2 update 
(v1.1.2) for all beta testers! We've tweaked the difficulty and there's a little surprise awaiting you in one of the Head 2 Head races!

The biggest new addition is the 40+ Steam achievements We are still testing these so let us know if you find any bugs but we're confident they'll keep you striving for the next milestone by fighting hard and driving fast!!

Achievements will also feature Rude Racers Ranks! Win trophies and see your Rank improve-- from the fumbling beginnings of the Rookie to the coveted Top-Dogg badge, the journey is full of excitement!

Join our open Beta Testers' Group and request a key here

notes.title: Season 2: High Speed Dirt Beta- FINAL ROUND IS LIVE!!
notes.content:
Thanks to all our testers for their support so far!

After chatting with all of you and studying the analytics data, we are now finally prepared to publish the final iteration of the second season!

Season 2: High Speed Dirt  offers two brand new game modes- Hunter and Head 2 Head and we guarantee that this super-fast new season is going to keep you on the edge of your seat!

We've improved the AI in some places and further rebalanced the levels for a better overall experience. 

Here's a brief changelog for v1.1.1

- New rider- Electra Lopez!
- Added new events to Quickplay
- Fixed issue with mouse-pointer drifting when using the joystick
- A brand new music track for the gameplay!

It's time to jump on your favourite bike and hit the streets! We plan to add achievements and introduce Season 3 in the next week. 

Keep riding and keep fighting!
